_meta.source: MOE Post Secondary Admissions Exercise (PSE) pages for JC and MI, polytechnic, PFP, ITE 2 year and 3 year Higher Nitec; MOE Full SBB pages and FAQ; MOE press releases; SEAB SEC page
_meta.notes: Criteria apply to the first SEC cohort, who sit the SEC in 2027 and enter post secondary in 2028 through the Post Secondary Admissions Exercise (PSE). The PSE replaces the Joint Admissions Exercise, the PFP Admissions Exercise and the ITE Joint Intake Exercise; the DPP ends with the 2027 intake. NAFA and LASALLE admit directly, outside the PSE. Rows marked confirmed were read in full from the primary MOE and SEAB pages on 2026-11-11 (research/pse.md). Rows marked provisional rest on the 2026 or AY2027 course lists, on the institutions' own pages, or on wording MOE does not define; the 2028 course lists arrive in mid 2027. Structural rules are evaluated by the app. Performance rules are shown, and computed only from grades a student chooses to enter as targets.

destinations.name: ITE, Higher Nitec, straight into Year 2
destinations.feels: Hands on from the first week, on the equipment the industry uses.

structural.label: English at G2 or above

structural.note: Mathematics or Additional Mathematics, read at its G2 grade.

structural.label: Five subjects at G2 or above
structural.note: English, Mathematics and three more. G1 subjects are not counted.

performance.label: ELMAB3 19 or better, at G2 grades

performance.label: CCA points count for posting
performance.note: Up to 2 points come off your score for posting. The 19 is read before they come off.

alsoIn: Early admissions looks at interest, before results.
From 2028, this skips Year 1 of the 3 year course. The DPP takes its last students in 2027.
A raw Higher Nitec GPA of 3.5 or more guarantees a place in a matching polytechnic course.

structural.label: English at G1 or above
structural.note: Two of the five score types name English. Which courses use which type arrives in mid 2027.

structural.label: Four subjects at G1 or above
structural.note: Each of the five score types counts four subjects, read at G1 grades.

performance.label: Open to every SEC student
performance.note: Four subjects, read at G1 grades, on one of five score types. The MOE page gives no maximum score. Each course also sets minimum grades.

performance.label: Grades three of the four need
performance.note: On four score types, three subjects need G3 E8, G2 5 or G1 D or better. The named subjects are among them.

performance.label: CCA points count for posting
performance.note: Up to 2 points come off your score for posting.

alsoIn: One course, not two. You can leave after Year 2 with a Nitec and return later.

lower.label: Any levels in Sec 1 and 2
lower.note: In the SEC, four subjects at G1 or above. Every Sec 1 and 2 student takes four levelled subjects or more.

destinations.lowerHorizon: In the SEC, the 3 year Higher Nitec reads four subjects at G1 or above.

destinations.name: Junior College
destinations.feels: Fast pace and many essays. You narrow to a few subjects and study them in depth.

structural.label: English at G3
structural.note: L1 is English or Higher Mother Tongue. English must also reach C6.

structural.label: Mathematics or Additional Mathematics at G3
structural.move: Take Mathematics, or Additional Mathematics, at G3
structural.note: A G3 Mathematics at D7 or better is a grade floor.

structural.label: A Humanities subject at G3
structural.move: Take a Humanities subject at G3
structural.note: R1 is a Humanities subject. Higher Art and Higher Music count. Art, Music and Economics count only as the last subject.

structural.label: Three G3s in Humanities, Maths, Science
structural.move: Take a third Humanities, Maths or Science subject at G3
structural.note: R1, R2 and R3 of L1R4: a Humanities, a Mathematics or Science, and one more of these, all at G3. Only R4 can be any subject, Computing included.

structural.label: Five subjects at G3
structural.note: All five subjects counted in L1R4 must be G3.

performance.label: L1R4 of 16 or better, all at G3
performance.note: English or Higher Mother Tongue, a Humanities, a Mathematics or Science, one more of these, and your best other subject.

performance.label: Grade floors
performance.note: English C6 and G3 Mathematics D7. Mother Tongue D7 at G3, 5 at G2 or D at G1. Higher Mother Tongue E8 also counts.

performance.label: Conditional admission, if a floor is missed
performance.note: L1R4 12 or better, or 13 to 16 with A1 or A2 in all four R subjects. You must reach the grade within Year 1.

performance.label: Bonus points count for posting
performance.note: Up to 3 points come off for posting. A Language Elective Programme place adds 2 more. The 16 is read before they come off.

alsoIn: Direct School Admission takes talent, before results.
Mother Tongue and Higher Mother Tongue of one language count once. Religious Knowledge is not counted.

lower.label: English at G3
lower.note: In the SEC, English at G3 is L1, and it must reach C6.

lower.label: Mathematics at G3
lower.note: In the SEC, Mathematics or Additional Mathematics at G3. Additional Mathematics starts in Sec 3.

lower.label: Science and a Humanities at G3, or two Humanities
lower.move: Take Science and a Humanities at G3, or two Humanities
lower.note: In the SEC, a Humanities (R1) and one more Humanities, Maths or Science (R3), all at G3. Science is one subject in Sec 1 and 2, so one of the two is always a Humanities. Mother Tongue need not be G3.

destinations.lowerHorizon: In the SEC: five subjects at G3, including English, a Humanities, and Maths or a Science. Mother Tongue need not be G3.

performance.label: Grade floors

performance.label: Bonus points count for posting
performance.note: Up to 3 points come off for posting. A Language Elective Programme place adds 2 more. The 20 is read before they come off.

lower.label: English at G3
lower.note: In the SEC, English at G3 is L1, and it must reach C6.

lower.label: Mathematics at G3
lower.note: In the SEC, Mathematics or Additional Mathematics at G3. Additional Mathematics starts in Sec 3.

lower.label: Science and a Humanities at G3, or two Humanities
lower.move: Take Science and a Humanities at G3, or two Humanities
lower.note: In the SEC, a Humanities (R1) and one more Humanities, Maths or Science (R3), all at G3. Science is one subject in Sec 1 and 2, so one of the two is always a Humanities. Mother Tongue need not be G3.

destinations.lowerHorizon: In the SEC: five subjects at G3, including English, a Humanities, and Maths or a Science. Mother Tongue need not be G3.

destinations.name: NAFA and LASALLE
destinations.feels: You apply with a portfolio or an audition.
destinations.leadsTo: A diploma, then a degree or practice.

structural.label: English at G3
structural.note: NAFA and LASALLE, from the 2028 intake: G3 English at C6 or better.

structural.label: Four subjects at G3, English included
structural.note: Four other subjects count besides English, at most one of them at G2. With English at G3, that is four at G3.

structural.label: Five subjects at G2 or above
structural.note: 21 points or better across four other subjects. One may be G2. With four at G3, the lowest grade is read at its G2 value.

performance.label: 21 points or better in four other subjects
performance.note: English is separate, at G3 C6 or better. Three subjects count at G3 and one at its G2 value.

performance.label: A portfolio, audition or interview too
performance.note: Each programme sets its own test. Meeting the minimum does not guarantee a place.

performance.label: Apply to NAFA or LASALLE directly
performance.note: Both are outside the PSE. LASALLE runs early admissions in May and NAFA in June.

performance.label: NAFA Foundation Programme, one year
performance.note: A route into a NAFA diploma. It asks ELMAB3 of 15 or better, at G2 grades.

alsoIn: Start a portfolio now. It does not depend on your levels.
The NAFA Foundation Programme is a one year route in. It asks ELMAB3 of 15 or better, at G2 grades.
Early admissions at both are open to students with G2 and G3 subjects.

lower.label: English at G3
lower.note: NAFA and LASALLE both ask English at G3, C6 or better.

lower.label: Three of Maths, Science, Mother Tongue or a Humanities at G3
lower.move: Take three of Maths, Science, Mother Tongue or a Humanities at G3
lower.pool: Maths, Science, Mother Tongue or a Humanities
lower.note: In the SEC, four more subjects besides English count, at least three of them at G3. The strongest Humanities counts once.

destinations.lowerHorizon: In the SEC: English at G3, plus four subjects with at least three at G3. Then a portfolio or audition.

destinations.name: Polytechnic Foundation Programme
destinations.feels: A year at the polytechnic to build what your diploma needs.
destinations.leadsTo: Straight into Year 1 of a diploma.

structural.label: English at G2 or above
structural.note: ELMAB3 reads English at its G2 grade and asks grade 3 or better.

structural.label: Mathematics at G2 or above
structural.note: Mathematics or Additional Mathematics, at its G2 grade, grade 3 or better.

structural.label: Five subjects at G2 or above
structural.note: English, Mathematics and three more. G1 subjects are not counted.

performance.label: ELMAB3 12 or better
performance.note: English, Mathematics and your best three, at G2 grades. G1 subjects, G2 grades 5 and 6 and a G3 9 are not counted.

performance.label: Subject minimums, at G2 grades
performance.note: English 3, Mathematics 3, one relevant subject 3, and two other subjects 4. For a G3 subject, 3 means D7 or better.

performance.label: CCA points count for posting
performance.note: Up to 2 points come off your score for posting. The 12 is read before they come off.

alsoIn: You apply to a group of related courses. The diploma at the end is the same.
The three groups are Sciences; Design, Engineering and Technology; and Humanities, Art, Media and Business.

lower.note: In the SEC, Mathematics counts at G2 or above.

structural.label: Five subjects at G2 or above
structural.note: The fifth subject (B2) always counts at its G2 equivalent, so it can be a G2 subject. A G3 subject there earns no priority.

structural.label: Mathematics or Additional Mathematics at G3
structural.move: Take Mathematics, or Additional Mathematics, at G3
structural.note: Course types B, C and D count only Mathematics or Additional Mathematics as the first relevant subject, at G3. Type A courses, mostly business, humanities and media on the 2026 lists, can use another subject. The 2028 lists arrive in mid 2027.

performance.label: ELR2B2 of 22 or better, after CCA points
performance.note: English, two relevant subjects and your best other at G3, plus a fifth at its G2 value. Nursing reads 24.

performance.label: Grades that cannot count

performance.note: Types B, C and D count Mathematics or Additional Mathematics at G3. Type A courses can use another subject. The 2028 lists arrive mid 2027.

alsoIn: Early admissions can give you a place before results.
A fifth subject at G3 earns no priority over one at G2.

lower.label: English at G3

structural.label: Read from SEC results and levels

performance.note: And you miss JC, MI and polytechnic. Polytechnic is missed at a net ELR2B2 of 23 or more, or with no course minimum met.

performance.note: MOE does not define it on its pages. E8 or better is used here. Confirm with your school.

performance.label: With mostly G1 subjects
